title: Calculate one-dimensional quality recommendations

verify.summary: Fresh independent verification proved all five one-dimensional quality recommendations preserve peer gates, threshold, pipeline and sample while exposing exact values, counts and correct/false/missed deltas. The blur gate obeys lower-is-better inclusive maximum cutoff score <= cutoff; no serving mutation or optimizer was observed.
verify.resume_route: Lifecycle owner may close TASK-103 after this T2 PASS.

evidence_required: FT-011-AC-002 RED: complete run evidence exposes no face-size, detection-confidence, blur, brightness or pose recommendation with required current/proposed and outcome deltas; GREEN: five deterministic analyses each vary exactly one gate, retain every peer gate, and report sample, kept/rejected plus expected correct/false/missed changes; the lower-is-better blur fixture keeps scores at or below its maximum cutoff and rejects a score above it; decisive comparison: independent fixed fixtures vary each gate alone and inspect unchanged peer settings and exact result fields; artifact: focused output under .tasks/TASK-103-T2-FT-011-W2/.
purpose: Implement the accepted quality analyses directly over completed Calibration evidence without introducing a multidimensional optimizer.
success_outcome: Each of the five named quality gates can produce an explainable current/proposed recommendation and expected outcome delta while every other gate stays fixed.
anti_goals: Do not jointly optimize gates or introduce weights, a generic optimizer, search-grid product configuration or automatic apply.
Do not change threshold-profile calculation, worker execution, staff routes, promotion or retention.
Do not infer missing annotations or combine native pipeline results.

forbidden_scope: Serving-control state mutation and automatic apply
Threshold-profile logic, worker runtime, staff HTTP and retention
Production/operator datasets and unredacted participant information in evidence
stop_conditions: A required result cannot be produced without varying more than one quality gate or inventing an unaccepted weighted objective.
A blur recommendation cannot use the accepted lower-is-better maximum cutoff that keeps only score <= cutoff.
The calculation requires combining pipeline revisions or synthesizing absent ground truth.

constraints: Use the completed run's immutable annotation/outcome evidence and retained deterministic candidate values.

Evaluate face size, detection confidence, blur, brightness and pose separately while holding the threshold and all peer gates fixed; blur_score is lower-is-better, so its maximum cutoff keeps only score <= cutoff.
Expose current/proposed value, sample size, kept/rejected detections and expected correct/false/missed changes for every result.
invariants: No result changes more than one quality gate or introduces a weighted/joint objective.
SFace and Buffalo M results remain separate and derive only from explicit ground truth.
Calculation never mutates serving settings or revision.
verification_targets: Five fixed fixtures independently verify cutoff/range direction, exact current/proposed values, sample and kept/rejected plus correct/false/missed deltas; the blur fixture proves its lower-is-better maximum cutoff keeps score <= cutoff and rejects a score above it.
Before/after snapshots prove every non-target quality gate and serving setting stays unchanged and no joint optimizer/configuration surface exists.
